product.name: Open Nevada
product.tagline: Choose a world. Keep the save path clean.

campaignRule: Choose Fallout 1, Fallout 2, New Vegas, or Fallout 3 before creating a character. Every game has an isolated profile and save identity; TTW remains an edition shared by Fallout 3 and New Vegas and never merges existing standalone saves.
jamRule: JAM is modular for New Vegas and TTW. You can add it later, but saves created with JAM must keep it enabled.

campaigns.title: Fallout 1
campaigns.launcherDetail: Vault 13 entrance · one shared character and save
campaigns.character: One Vault Dweller profile shared by its views
campaigns.detail: Register the generated local cache, then launch the owned character creator, Overseer movie, and V13ENT in Hex Tactical or First Person.

campaigns.title: Fallout 2
campaigns.launcherDetail: Owned DAT2 install registered · Arroyo runtime pending
campaigns.character: One Chosen One profile shared by its future views
campaigns.detail: The owned master, critter, and patch archives are registered. Hex, FPS, and VR remain disabled until a player-controlled runtime presentation exists.

campaigns.title: New Vegas
campaigns.launcherDetail: Original menu and intro · Doc Mitchell · Goodsprings
campaigns.detail: Use the base profile, then add JAM whenever you are ready.

campaigns.title: Fallout 3
campaigns.launcherDetail: Owned menu and CG00 through stage 62 · FPS world pending
campaigns.detail: The owned frontend reaches persistent stage 62. FPS, Hex, and VR stay disabled until Vault 101 world progression exists.

campaigns.title: TTW
campaigns.launcherDetail: One character across both games · TTW install required
campaigns.detail: This is the TTW choice at character creation. Start base or add JAM later.
campaigns.assetRequirement: Licensed Fallout 3, New Vegas, DLC, and official TTW output

extenderLayers.title: Content records
extenderLayers.detail: Data plugins and assets are mounted through isolated profiles.

extenderLayers.title: Script-extender contract
extenderLayers.detail: Open Nevada implements portable behavior contracts instead of loading a Windows DLL into another runtime.

extenderLayers.title: Native Windows bridge
extenderLayers.detail: Windows-only plugins are profiled command-by-command, then promoted only after a portable equivalent is verified.

mods.title: Tale of Two Wastelands
mods.detail: The local TTW output can be hash-bound now; record, script, archive, and world-transition runtime compilation is still pending.

mods.title: Just Assorted Mods
mods.detail: Owned JAM 4.6 data transports desktop JVS sprint and JBT time dilation. Missing native prerequisites and remaining AP, UI, animation, audio, event, and save semantics keep complete JAM play disabled.

mods.title: Benny Humbles You and Steals Your Stuff
mods.detail: Queued for the OpenNV semantic extender bridge; not represented as portable support until the required behaviors pass.
